subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: The Zero-Emission Warehouse
description: A 60-second lesson on The Zero-Emission Warehouse.

hook.text: Solar panels on the roof, geothermal heating below, and electric forklifts inside. Net-zero warehousing is real.

buildup.text: Zero-emission warehouses generate or offset all their energy use through renewables and efficiency measures.

discovery.text: LED lighting, smart HVAC, solar panels, and battery storage slash energy use by 40–60% vs. conventional buildings.

twist.text: Building green costs 5–15% more upfront. But energy savings pay back the premium within 3–7 years.

climax.text: Prologis, the world's largest warehouse owner, aims for net-zero across its 1 billion+ sq ft portfolio.

punchline.text: Green warehouses cost more to build and less to run. Forever.

quiz.question: How much can green warehouses reduce energy use?
